name: SD: Supply chain (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A small supply chain, every day: cases in the shop and in the warehouse, and the diesel at the depot. Every case shipped to the shop burns half a litre of diesel (a co-flow), and fuel deliveries top the depot back up, so when demand is high the trucks run short of fuel and the shop runs down. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-supply/truth.model.json, including something nobody counts), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
